$comment: The platform contract (constitution Article VIII). This blank template is INJECTED by Architect when the app is generated — read it, never hand-invent it. A capability not listed here is a capability this app does not have. Item shapes inside tools/connections/playbooks are strings for now; the schema tolerates unknown keys so this app stays valid as the platform adds fields. `env` is pre-seeded with TABX_URL, OLTP_URL and OLTP_SCHEMA because the platform sets all three on EVERY app (constitution Articles XIV and XV); Architect appends whatever else an app was granted.
